features.title: New thread never waits on jj
features.summary: The sidebar's New thread, the palette and the project picker open the composer at once; with isolation on by default, the blank thread moves to its own jj workspace (a spare when available, but never the inherited source workspace) in the background while the chip names it. The composer stays editable; a submitted message waits only if that move is still in progress. A thread left in another thread's workspace moves back to the project checkout when isolation is off.

An inherited thread workspace is not reused as the new thread's own destination, even when it is registered as a spare.

features.title: Rebase a thread onto the bookmark
features.summary: The conversation header identifies the current thread's jj workspace and opens its workspace panel. Rebase a thread's described work onto the target bookmark and advance it from the thread header, panel, or `/rebase` composer command. The in-chat notice shows the tip change ID and offers Archive for the current thread. The command refuses non-thread workspaces and Rebase is disabled while any thread session is working or waiting for input. Conflicts and undescribed revisions are handed back to the thread's agent. Afterwards the checkout running DSH follows the bookmark in the background through `dshx checkout sync`, with a panel line saying what was rebuilt and whether to restart.

features.title: Thread workspaces page

Rows show conversation titles with open links and lazy message previews; Rebase is disabled until every thread session is stopped and no user question is pending. A successful rebase immediately marks its row up to date while the refreshed repository data arrives. Removal confirms folder and registry effects and any revisions to abandon.
